solver_notes: Native deterministic Rust regression model executed on the RAK Miner v2 aarch64 host. Legacy local-only polling reproduces starvation: an unyielding nested future is polled 128 times while global work receives zero polls. The fixed lane decrements cooperative budget on every local poll and forces a global fallback check every 64 ticks; the global task first executes at tick 64. Stress executed 1000 fallback rounds (64000 ticks) with 1000 global checks. Scope: standalone native reproduction/fix for the stated scheduler invariant, not a claimed patch to upstream Tokio. Initial test expectations were corrected from actual observed accounting: two fallback ticks among 128 leave 126 local polls; 1000 among 64000 leave 63000. Final tests are green.
